question: Evaluate 6.9 - [8.6 - {6.5 - (5.4-overline{4.3-2})}].
solution:
**Given:**

6.9 - [8.6 - {6.5 - (5.4 - overline{4.3-2})}]

**Concept Used:**

Follow the VBODMAS rule according to the given below

 
 

 V
 Vinniculam or Bar ( ¯ ) needs to operate first then brackets
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6027055d9c8a1c25052fc382493ecb75174631c0a668d89e918191d2efd88b19.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6.9 - [8.6 - {6.5 - (5.4 - overline{4.3-2})}]

⇒ 6.9 - [8.6 - {6.5 - (5.4 - 2.3)}]

⇒ 6.9 - [8.6 - {6.5 - 3.1}]

⇒ 6.9 - [8.6 - 3.4]

⇒ 6.9 - 5.2 = 1.7

**∴ The correct answer is option 4**
